subject: Taxes
title: Trust in Government and Compliance
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Trust in Government and Compliance.

hook.text: In Denmark, 96% of taxes are paid voluntarily and on time. In Greece, tax evasion costs 15% of GDP. The difference?

buildup.text: When people trust their government uses taxes well, they pay willingly.

discovery.text: Studies across 50 countries show that a 10% increase in government trust correlates with a 3% decrease in tax evasion.

twist.text: Corruption is the biggest trust-killer. In countries where officials visibly steal.

climax.text: Tax compliance is not about enforcement alone—it's about the social contract.

punchline.text: Trust buys compliance. Corruption seeds evasion. It's social, not legal.

quiz.question: What is the biggest factor in voluntary tax compliance across countries?
